entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for some cycling shoes. I just need the shipping label.
I can definitely assist you with that. To pull up your order, could I please have your name or order number?
Order is 94-Charlie-51. Just process the return.
Thank you. I have the order right here. And for our records, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
They don't work for me. The fit is wrong, the position for the cleats feels off, and they're giving me terrible blisters after just one ride. I don't want to troubleshoot it, I just want a refund.

I understand completely. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery was 27 days ago. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe.
Good. So you're emailing me the label?

Yes, I've just approved the return now. You should receive an email with a pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
